about: ROUTE R2, THE CANYON TRAIL (One World phase 4.1, the owner's north routes thread, 2026-11-17): a trail from the River Road's junction (plots 0,-4 and 1,-4, in the River Road's room) north up a dry canyon behind the Hills to the foot of Mount Shasta. ONE room, 22 plots (the list's 2 to 23; 3 x 10). Its south end is the junction's seam ow_h_1_m4. At its top the trail turns west along two more plots (`add`, mondo's yes 2026-11-17: -2,-14 and -3,-14, past plots.json's band) and climbs north into Shasta's Trailhead (-3,-15) on its south side, west of the Woods door (seam ow_h_m3_m14). ONE room, 24 plots. PLACES (ow-places.js, every name an idea of Claude's): the page's ranger station stands at the junction (River Road's room); the rest are the kit's picks by the ground.
